name: Screen the Screener
idea: Set a screen for a teammate, then get a screen yourself and cut to the hoop.
why: Everyone watches the first screen. Nobody expects the player who set it to get a screen right after, so their defender gets caught.
tryit: Screeners: count to two after your screen, then go. The first cutter really sells it, so the defense watches them.

frames.say: {1} passes in from behind the baseline. {4} is about to set a screen, and then get one.
{4} sets a screen for {2}, and {2} pops out to the wing. Everyone watches {2}.
*Screen the screener:* Now {5} sets a screen on {X4}, the defender of the player who just screened.
{4} cuts to the basket. {X4} runs right into {5}!
{1} passes in to {4}, all alone under the hoop.
Layup! The player who sets a screen can get one too.
